first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: Walking along the bridge with their back to the camera, wearing a brownish-tan pointed wide-brimmed hat, with a long braid hanging down the back, and dressed in gray-green long sleeves, a dark vest, and a dark brown long skirt.

entities.name: Layered Rocky Hills
entities.identification: A gray to grayish-brown rocky hill with step-like rock strata behind the far end of the bridge.

entities.name: Blue Sky and White Clouds
entities.identification: The pale cyan-blue sky and large white cloud masses in the upper part of the image, with a bright upper-right area.

entities.name: Tall Grass by the Bridge and Vegetation on the Grassy Slope
entities.identification: Green clumps of grass by the bridge and on the slope on the right, including long leaves in the foreground, pale grass heads, and purple flower spikes on the right in the early portion.

entities.name: Distant Flat-Topped Mountain
entities.identification: A blue-gray mountain in the distant upper left, with a relatively flat top and steep mountain walls.

entities.name: Gray-Blue Stone-Slab Bridge Deck
entities.identification: A gray-blue stone-slab path between the stone railings on both sides, converging from the foreground toward the far end.

entities.name: Reddish-Brown Stone Railings on Both Sides of the Bridge
entities.identification: Low reddish-brown stone railings on both sides of the bridge; the repeated arched openings in the left railing are clear, and there is a moss-covered square stone block at the near end on the right.

entities.name: Dark Boulder on the Right
entities.identification: A large dark gray, nearly black rock at the top of the slope on the right, with an irregular top and a brighter rock face on the right.

entities.name: Rocky Slope on the Right
entities.identification: A gray-green rocky slope below the boulder on the right, descending steeply to below the bridge deck.

entities.name: Blue-Gray Water Surface on the Left
entities.identification: A blue-gray horizontal water surface partially visible outside the stone railing on the left and below the rock wall in the mist.

entities.name: Canyon Rock Wall on the Left
entities.identification: A tall rock-wall area behind the water surface on the left, fading into blue-gray mist.

entities.name: Tall Tree and Small Tree atop the Rocky Hill
entities.identification: A group of trees atop the rocky hill, with a taller tree on the right and a shorter tree on the left; the tall tree has a larger crown, while the small tree has a thinner trunk and smaller crown.

Joints between masonry blocks, irregular opening edges, and yellow-green moss are visible nearby; the inner face of the right stone railing is darker, and at the near end on the right are stacked square stone blocks whose top surface is covered with moss.
